name: invalid-suite-tags-item-too-short-no-globs
description: A suite whose only tags item is empty and has no globs fails just the item's own min-length check: the refine reads the raw tags array (still length 1) so it does not also fire the missing-selector rule.
yaml:
project: Demo
apps:
  - id: main
    platform: android
    appId: com.example.app
environments:
  staging:
    app: main
suites:
  smoke:
    tags: [""]
